name: wayfare
description: Travel assistant: one ChatGPT Site per trip from your Gmail bookings, with trip checks, weather, live flight status, packing lists and travel tips. Never books or pays.

interface.longDescription: Travel assistant for your booked trips. Wayfare reads flight, train, hotel and restaurant confirmations from your Gmail and gives each trip its own ChatGPT Site: the trip day by day with the weather, alerts for nights with no stay booked, tight connections, late check-ins, schedule changes and live delays, a Good to know tab (what to pack, local tips, getting around), a shared to-do list and a calendar file. Its tools check a trip plan, get the trip weather and make a packing list. It checks every morning and on new booking emails. It never books, changes, cancels or pays.
defaultPrompt: Set up Wayfare for my trips
Check my inbox for new trips
What do I need to pack?
